properties.title: Argo CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with PACE matchups
properties.description:
Per-profile CHLA metrics from global BGC-Argo floats (Mar 2024–Oct 2026), ascending profiles only, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < PRES <= B) from CHLA_ADJUSTED levels with CHLA_ADJUSTED_QC in {1, 2, 5, 8}. Source: Ifremer ERDDAP via argopy 1.5.0 (expert mode), pulled 2026-11-06. Matched to PACE OCI Level-3 4 km Daily V3.2 Rrs (PACE_OCI_L3M_AOP), chlor_a (PACE_OCI_L3M_BGC) and Kd_490 (PACE_OCI_L3M_KD, band 489.674 nm): a profile matches a granule when its time is within 24 h after the granule's time_coverage_start, at the nearest 4 km cell; standard files are used before NRT. Only profiles with a matching Rrs granule are kept; Rrs is NaN where the pixel was masked (cloud, glint).

How to load

ASSET_URL use 'Copy URL' on left

Python df = pandas.read_parquet('ASSET_URL')

R  df <- arrow::read_parquet('ASSET_URL')
